description:
RD Station CRM is the sales management platform used by thousands of sales teams. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your RD account, allowing you to query and update your operations without leaving the conversation.

With it, you can analyze the sales funnel and identify stalled deals, generate monthly closing forecasts, prepare a comprehensive account briefing before a meeting, understand the quarter's top reasons for lost deals, and monitor the team's task workload.

You can also log recent activity: record call summaries within a deal, create follow-up tasks, register new companies and contacts, create deals in the appropriate funnel, and link catalog products to a proposal.

Coverage extends to deals, contacts, companies, tasks, products, funnels and stages, campaigns, sources, segments, loss reasons, custom fields, users, and teams. The plugin accesses only the account data you authorize and does not perform deletions—no CRM records can be erased through it.

defaultPrompt: Analise meu funil de vendas e aponte os negócios parados há mais tempo na mesma etapa.
Resuma os principais motivos de perda dos negócios deste trimestre e sugira o que atacar primeiro.
Registre o resumo desta ligação no negócio da Empresa ABC e crie uma tarefa de follow-up para sexta.
